teachers:
TOSA Koji
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: Learn basics of physical, organic, and inorganic chemistry through active learning methods using exercises. Will provide an understanding of chemistry for related classes.
advice:
Physical Chemistry Practices
 Properties of gases, thermodynamics, quantum chemistry, chemical equilibria, and rates of chemical reactions
Organic Chemistry Practices
 Structures and bonding, alkanes, alkenes, alkynes, organohalides, aromatics
Inorganic Chemistry Practices
 Main group elements, transition elements, solution chemistry, coordination compounds
books: Textbooks: Basic Organic Chemistry[Sankyo Shuppan], Inorganic Chemistry 2nd Edition[Tokyo Kagaku Dojin], Elements of Physical Chemistry 6th Edition[Tokyo Kagaku Dojin]
requiredKnowledge: A basic understanding of physics, physical chemistry, organic chemistry, inorganic chemistry, and mathematics (exponential, logarithmic, and differential calculus) is necessary.

              Learn basics of physical, organic, and inorganic chemistry through active learning methods using exercises. Will provide an understanding of chemistry for related classes.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              Physical Chemistry Practices
 Properties of gases, thermodynamics, quantum chemistry, chemical equilibria, and rates of chemical reactions
Organic Chemistry Practices
 Structures and bonding, alkanes, alkenes, alkynes, organohalides, aromatics
Inorganic Chemistry Practices
 Main group elements, transition elements, solution chemistry, coordination compounds

              教科書および参考書・リザーブドブック

              Textbooks: Basic Organic Chemistry[Sankyo Shuppan], Inorganic Chemistry 2nd Edition[Tokyo Kagaku Dojin], Elements of Physical Chemistry 6th Edition[Tokyo Kagaku Dojin]

              履修に必要な予備知識や技能

              A basic understanding of physics, physical chemistry, organic chemistry, inorganic chemistry, and mathematics (exponential, logarithmic, and differential calculus) is necessary.
